name: Potential Persistence Via Custom Protocol Handler
description: Detects potential persistence activity via the registering of a new custom protocole handlers. While legitimate applications register protocole handlers often times during installation. And attacker can abuse this by setting a custom handler to be used as a persistence mechanism.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Many legitimate applications can register a new custom protocol handler. Additional filters needs to applied according to your environment.
query: (registry.path:HKCR\\* AND winlog.event_data.Details:URL\:*) AND (NOT (winlog.event_data.Details:URL\:ms\-* OR (process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*))))
